data.rationale: The proposal follows the same steps in the same order (IMDb lookup, then Rotten Tomatoes, then the mail draft with matching subject and body templates) and captures the film and day parameters, but it gets the final step wrong by saying "save or send" where the true workflow says not to send and to click Discard; it also splits friend into separate email and name parameters (the email is just {friend}@example.com) and refers to the name in the body as {name}, which doesn't match recipient_name.
